title: Neo4j backend: secrets never leak; projects never bleed into each other

cases.title: index_status output does not contain the password (the harness masks the real value as ***)
list_projects output does not contain the password
the marker file never holds the password
cases.shell: {{python}} -c "import os,sys; t=open(sys.argv[1]+'.graph.json',encoding='utf-8').read(); pw=os.environ.get('NEO4J_PASSWORD',''); print('marker_has_password', bool(pw) and pw in t)" "{{db_path}}"

cases.title: no log under the cache dir holds the password
cases.shell:
{{python}} -c "import glob,os,sys; pw=os.environ.get('NEO4J_PASSWORD',''); hits=0
for p in glob.glob(os.path.join(sys.argv[1],'logs','**','*'),recursive=True):
    if os.path.isfile(p) and pw and pw in open(p,'rb').read().decode('utf-8','replace'): hits+=1
print('hits=%d'%hits)" "{{cache_dir}}"

cases.title: no eval result/stderr file holds the password

SCOPE: no foreign project rows under this project's db key
cases.cypher: MATCH (n:CbmNode {db: $project}) WHERE n.project <> $project AND NOT n.project ENDS WITH '::missed' RETURN count(n)

cases.title: SCOPE: File count via engine on project A
SCOPE: File count via engine on project B (same repo) is the same number, read from B's rows only
SCOPE: Neo4j holds 2x that many File rows across both projects (so A's count was not 'all of Neo4j')
cases.cypher: MATCH (n:CbmNode {label: 'File'}) WHERE n.db IN [$a, $b] AND n.project IN [$a, $b] RETURN count(n)
